bullet_facts.fact: Dwight asked Michael for permission to ask out Katy, and Michael said he would be giving her a ride home later.
Dwight expressed a desire to ask out Katy, and Michael told him he would be giving her a ride home.
In S03E03, Dwight told Michael he thinks he can run the branch better than him, indicating some tension in their relationship.
Michael and Dwight have a close relationship, as shown by their firm embrace and Dwight promising to never betray Michael again.
Michael and Dwight have had romantic relationships with other people, but their relationship is complex and includes moments of support and conflict.
In S07E04, Michael and Dwight's relationship is shown to be close, with moments of humor and support, such as Dwight saying 'You can get up. Get up. And you can hug it out, bitch.'

Dwight: Michael could I ask you something? I wanted to ask your permission to ask out Katy. I know it's against the rules and everything. Because…
